packageRules.description: go.yaml.in/yaml/v4 is a release candidate, so updates within the v4 pre-release track are expected rather than exceptional.
getsops pulls the cloud KMS SDKs in with it, so a sops bump moves a large tail of indirect dependencies. Keeping them together lets CI prove the combination before it lands.
Everything else non-major in one PR; CI gates it.
Go itself moves via the go directive in go.mod, which setup-go reads; treat it as a deliberate choice rather than an automatic bump.
